'''Brindy Truchong''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. She flew a [[Freighter/Legends|modified freighter]]<ref name="Brindy" /> and was an ally of gun-runner and fellow Corellian [[Laudica]].<ref name="Laudica card">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Laudica}}</ref> Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Truchong was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where she hoped to quickly gather supplies that she could provide to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Brindy" /> She was conversing with an individual on the streets of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] passed her by on their way to [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|Docking Bay 94]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Brindy Truchong first appeared in {{Film|IV}} as an unnamed background character.<ref name="ANH" /> She received a name and short backstory in [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name=Corellian card">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Corellian}}</ref>
